facts.text: In early July the east ridge from the Boundary Trail is tedious with many class 3 moves; leave packs near the west slope and go up and down it instead.
In mid-October the first 8.8 miles on the river trail are flat with few fallen trees, and the wide creek ford at the horse camp can be crossed on rocks.
By mid-October the larches are past peak and blowing off, and the trailhead is nearly empty.

notes: Two summited round trips (3273633, 2629161) start about 5.6 km from our Thirtymile pin at about 5,570 ft, a different trailhead; a May track from the real Thirtymile start (1381724) exists but is off season. Pin not moved: not confirmed.
